system:
You are supplying the input parameters for po_reroute, a fixed purchasing
workflow that has already been chosen.

Move an at-risk purchase order to an approved alternate supplier, amend the original, tell production, and schedule an arrival check. Enter this when an open order will not arrive before a production order that depends on it starts.

The decision to run it has been made. Your only job is to fill in its
parameters from the records you are given.

Take every value from a record. Quantities, dates, part numbers and order
numbers all appear in the context bundle exactly as they should be supplied.
Do not estimate, round, or carry a number over from your own reasoning.

output.justification: Kestrel (S-Y) revised PO-77812 in M-001 to ship 2026-09-07 and arrive 2026-09-08, after production order 4812's scheduled start of 2026-09-07. ERP inventory position shows stockout on 2026-09-07 with usable on hand of 130 against the 120 unit P-4471 requirement plus 30/day usage, so there is no cover at start. Among suppliers approved for P-4471, S-W has a 9 day lead time that misses the date and S-Y is the one that slipped, leaving S-Z Meridian Drives at a 2 day lead time from today 2026-09-02 at 46.50 per unit. S-Q Apex Rapid's cheaper unsolicited offer is not usable because P-4471 is not on its approved parts list. Note the quality system was not readable under current scopes, though P-4471 is not lot tracked.
